name: cheap-explore
description: Zero-cost enforcement of an explicit model tier on the built-in Explore, Plan, and general-purpose agents. They carry no model pin, so a dispatch that omits the Agent tool's model parameter silently runs at the full session-model rate. A PreToolUse hook denies those dispatches and tells the model to retry with haiku or sonnet. Injects nothing at session start — costs tokens only on an actual miss.
